SELECT ,
CASE WHEN wp.is_top = 1 AND wp.top_expire_time > NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isTop,
CASE WHEN wp.is_timing = 1 AND wp.publish_time > NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isTiming,
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wall_post_action a WHERE a.post_no = wp.post_no AND a.user_uid = #{currentUserUid} AND a.action_type = 'LIKE') AS isLike, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wall_post_action a WHERE a.post_no = wp.post_no AND a.user_uid = #{currentUserUid} AND a.action_type = 'COLLECT') AS isCollect
0 AS isLike, 0 AS isCollect
FROM wall_post wp LEFT JOIN user u ON wp.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN wall_category wc ON wp.category_id = wc.id AND wc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wall_category_sub wcs ON wp.sub_category_id = wcs.id AND wcs.is_deleted = 0
wp.is_deleted = 0
AND (wp.publish_time IS NULL OR wp.publish_time <= NOW())
AND wp.user_id = #{userId}
AND wp.category_id IN
#{catId}
AND (
(wp.category_id = #{item.categoryId} AND wp.sub_category_id = #{item.subCategoryId})
)
AND wp.status = #{status} AND wp.is_anonymous = #{isAnonymous}
AND ( wp.content LIKE #{likeKey} OR (wp.is_anonymous = 0 AND wp.nickname LIKE #{likeKey}) OR wc.name LIKE #{likeKey} OR wcs.name LIKE #{likeKey} )
ORDER BY isTop DESC, COALESCE(wp.publish_time, wp.create_time) DESC, wp.create_time DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wall_post (post_no,user_id,category_id,sub_category_id,nickname,avatar,is_anonymous, content,view_count,like_count,collect_count, comment_count,status,is_top,top_expire_time,publish_time,is_timing, is_deleted,create_time,update_time) VALUES (#{postNo},#{userId},#{categoryId},#{subCategoryId},#{nickname},#{avatar},#{isAnonymous}, #{content},#{viewCount},#{likeCount},#{collectCount}, #{commentCount},#{status},#{isTop}, DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL #{topHour} HOUR) NULL, #{publishTime},#{isTiming}, #{isDeleted},NOW(),NOW())

UPDATE wall_post
nickname = #{nickname}, avatar = #{avatar}, category_id = #{categoryId}, sub_category_id = #{subCategoryId}, is_anonymous = #{isAnonymous}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, is_top = #{isTop},
top_expire_time = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{topHour} HOUR), top_expire_time = NULL, top_expire_time = #{topExpireTime},
is_timing = #{isTiming},
publish_time = #{publishTime}, publish_time = NULL, publish_time = #{publishTime},
view_count = #{viewCount}, like_count = #{likeCount}, collect_count = #{collectCount}, comment_count = #{commentCount}, update_time = #{updateTime}
WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE wall_post SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE wall_post SET view_count = IFNULL(view_count, 0) + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE post_no = #{postNo} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE wall_post SET like_count = GREATEST(IFNULL(like_count, 0) + #{delta}, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE post_no = #{postNo} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE wall_post SET collect_count = GREATEST(IFNULL(collect_count, 0) + #{delta}, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE post_no = #{postNo} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE wall_post SET comment_count = GREATEST(IFNULL(comment_count, 0) + #{delta}, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
